cues.text: That's a concerning state of immune deficiency, and you can perhaps understand why we're now finding

cues.text: significant links between short sleep duration and your risk for the development of numerous forms of cancer.

cues.text: So here in this study, they took a group of healthy adults

cues.zh: 他們被限制每晚只能睡六個小時， 實驗持續一個星期，

cues.zh: 實驗持續一個星期， 之後我們測量了他們的 基因活動方面的改變， 再與同樣這批人

cues.en: caused by a lack of sleep.

cues.text: The other half were decreased.
cues.en: The other half were decreased.

cues.text: Now those genes that were switched off by a lack of sleep were genes associated with your immune system,
cues.en: Now those genes that were switched off by a lack of sleep were genes associated with your immune system,
cues.zh: 那些因為缺乏睡眠而被關掉的基因 是與免疫系統相關的基因，

cues.text: so once again, you can see that immune deficiency.
cues.en: so once again, you can see that immune deficiency.

cues.text: In contrast, those genes that were actually upregulated or increased by way of a lack of sleep,
cues.en: In contrast, those genes that were actually upregulated or increased by way of a lack of sleep,
cues.zh: 相對來說，那些因為睡眠不足 而被迫提高活動力的基因， 或是總數增加的基因， 即是那些促進腫瘤形成的基因，

cues.text: There is simply no aspect of your wellness

cues.text: that can retreat at the sign of sleep deprivation and get away unscathed.

cues.en: The first is regularity.
cues.zh: 第一個是規律。

cues.text: Go to bed at the same time, wake up at the same time, no matter whether it's the weekday or the weekend.
cues.en: Go to bed at the same time, wake up at the same time, no matter whether it's the weekday or the weekend.
cues.zh: 固定時間上床，固定時間起床， 週間週末都一樣。

cues.en: Regularity is king, and it will anchor your sleep

cues.text: and improve the quantity and the quality of that sleep.

cues.text: The second is keep it cool.

cues.text: Well, I think it may be this: sleep, unfortunately, is not an optional lifestyle luxury.

cues.zh: 嗯，我想應該可以這麼說： 睡眠並不是奢華生活的選項。

cues.en: Sleep is a nonnegotiable biological necessity.

cues.text: It is your life-support system, and it is Mother Nature's best effort yet at immortality.
cues.en: It is your life-support system, and it is Mother Nature's best effort yet at immortality.
cues.zh: 它是你的維生系統， 也是大自然帶給人類 不老的最好方法。

cues.text: And the decimation of sleep throughout industrialized nations

cues.text: even the safety and the education of our children.
cues.en: even the safety and the education of our children.

cues.text: It's a silent sleep loss epidemic, and it's fast becoming one of the greatest public health challenges
cues.en: It's a silent sleep loss epidemic, and it's fast becoming one of the greatest public health challenges
cues.zh: 這個悄然無聲的睡眠不足疫情， 正迅速成為人們在 21 世紀面臨的

cues.text: that we face in the 21st century.
cues.en: that we face in the 21st century.

cues.en: I believe it is now time for us to reclaim our right

cues.text: to a full night of sleep, and without embarrassment

cues.en: Thank you very much indeed.
cues.zh: 祝大家都睡得好。 非常謝謝各位。 （掌聲）

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。

cues.text: Thank you so much.
cues.en: Thank you so much.
cues.zh: 非常謝謝大家。

cues.text: David Biello: No, no. Stay there for a second.
cues.en: David Biello: No, no. Stay there for a second.
cues.zh: 非常謝謝大家。 比艾羅：等等，先別走。

cues.text: Good job not running away, though. I appreciate that.
cues.en: Good job not running away, though. I appreciate that.
cues.zh: 謝謝留下來多講幾句話。

cues.text: So that was terrifying.
cues.en: So that was terrifying.
cues.zh: 今天的主題太可怕了。 馬特‧沃克：不客氣。 比艾羅：謝謝。

cues.text: Matt Walker: You're welcome. DB: Yes, thank you, thank you.
cues.en: Matt Walker: You're welcome. DB: Yes, thank you, thank you.
cues.zh: 馬特‧沃克：不客氣。 比艾羅：謝謝。

cues.text: Since we can't catch up on sleep, what are we supposed to do?
cues.en: Since we can't catch up on sleep, what are we supposed to do?
cues.zh: 比：如果補眠是沒有幫助的， 那我們能做什麼呢？ 例如，當我們晚上在床上 翻來覆去無法入睡，

cues.text: What do we do when we're, like, tossing and turning in bed late at night
cues.en: What do we do when we're, like, tossing and turning in bed late at night
cues.zh: 例如，當我們晚上在床上 翻來覆去無法入睡，

cues.text: or doing shift work or whatever else?
cues.en: or doing shift work or whatever else?
cues.zh: 或因為上夜班或其他因素 不能睡覺怎麼辦？

cues.text: MW: So you're right, we can't catch up on sleep.
cues.en: MW: So you're right, we can't catch up on sleep.
cues.zh: 馬：你說對了，補眠不能解決問題。

cues.text: Sleep is not like the bank.
cues.en: Sleep is not like the bank.
cues.zh: 睡眠跟銀行貸款不一樣。

cues.text: You can't accumulate a debt and then hope to pay it off at a later point in time.
cues.en: You can't accumulate a debt and then hope to pay it off at a later point in time.
cues.zh: 你不能累積債務， 期望之後再來一次還清。

cues.text: I should also note the reason that it's so catastrophic and that our health deteriorates so quickly,
cues.en: I should also note the reason that it's so catastrophic and that our health deteriorates so quickly,
cues.zh: 我應該也要指出問題之所以如此嚴重 以及健康惡化如此之快的原因，

cues.text: first, it's because human beings are the only species that deliberately deprive themselves of sleep
cues.en: first, it's because human beings are the only species that deliberately deprive themselves of sleep
cues.zh: 首先，人類這個物種大概是唯一 會自己剝奪自己的睡眠

cues.text: for no apparent reason.
cues.en: for no apparent reason.
cues.zh: 且沒有明顯的理由。

cues.text: DB: Because we're smart.
cues.en: DB: Because we're smart.
cues.zh: 比：因為我們很聰明。

cues.text: MW: And I make that point because it means that Mother Nature,
cues.en: MW: And I make that point because it means that Mother Nature,
cues.zh: 馬：我講這一點是因為大自然 在整個進化過程中，

cues.text: throughout the course of evolution, has never had to face the challenge of this thing called sleep deprivation.
cues.en: throughout the course of evolution, has never had to face the challenge of this thing called sleep deprivation.
cues.zh: 在整個進化過程中， 從來沒有面臨過 「睡眠剝奪」的挑戰。

cues.text: So she's never developed a safety net, and that's why when you undersleep,
cues.en: So she's never developed a safety net, and that's why when you undersleep,
cues.zh: 所以也沒有發展出安全網， 因此當你缺乏睡眠時，

cues.text: things just sort of implode so quickly, both within the brain and the body.
cues.en: things just sort of implode so quickly, both within the brain and the body.
cues.zh: 因此當你缺乏睡眠時， 你的腦部與身體 很快就崩潰無法招架。

cues.text: So you just have to prioritize.
cues.en: So you just have to prioritize.
cues.zh: 所以你只能用輕重緩急 決定優先順序。

cues.text: DB: OK, but tossing and turning in bed, what do I do?
cues.en: DB: OK, but tossing and turning in bed, what do I do?
cues.zh: 比：好，可是當我在床上輾轉難眠時， 我能做什麼？ 馬：當你躺在床上很久仍了無睡意，

cues.text: MW: So if you are staying in bed awake for too long,
cues.en: MW: So if you are staying in bed awake for too long,
cues.zh: 馬：當你躺在床上很久仍了無睡意，

cues.text: you should get out of bed and go to a different room and do something different.
cues.en: you should get out of bed and go to a different room and do something different.
cues.zh: 不如起床，去另一個房間 做點什麼不同的事。

cues.text: The reason is because your brain will very quickly associate your bedroom
cues.en: The reason is because your brain will very quickly associate your bedroom
cues.zh: 不然你的大腦很快就會把你的臥室

cues.text: with the place of wakefulness, and you need to break that association.
cues.en: with the place of wakefulness, and you need to break that association.
cues.zh: 跟清醒狀態連結在一起， 你必須打破那個連結。

cues.text: So only return to bed when you are sleepy, and that way you will relearn the association that you once had,
cues.en: So only return to bed when you are sleepy, and that way you will relearn the association that you once had,
cues.zh: 當你睡意來了再回去臥室， 那樣子你才能重建以前的連結──

cues.text: which is your bed is the place of sleep.
cues.en: which is your bed is the place of sleep.
cues.zh: 也就是床等於睡覺之處。

cues.text: So the analogy would be, you'd never sit at the dinner table, waiting to get hungry,
cues.en: So the analogy would be, you'd never sit at the dinner table, waiting to get hungry,
cues.zh: 也就是床等於睡覺之處。 這也有點類似， 你不會去坐在餐桌等飢餓感，

cues.text: so why would you lie in bed, waiting to get sleepy?
cues.en: so why would you lie in bed, waiting to get sleepy?
cues.zh: 所以你為什麼要躺在床上等睡意？

cues.text: DB: Well, thank you for that wake-up call.
cues.en: DB: Well, thank you for that wake-up call.
cues.zh: 比：嗯，謝謝你的醒世之喚。

cues.text: Great job, Matt.
cues.en: Great job, Matt.
cues.zh: 很棒的演說，馬特。 馬：不客氣。謝謝大家。

cues.text: MW: You're very welcome. Thank you very much.
cues.en: MW: You're very welcome. Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 馬：不客氣。謝謝大家。
